components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The decisive action that advances a reading or setup flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--brand-accent, #E8DAC3); color: var(--text-on-brand, #1C1A22); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; transition: background-color 200ms var(--ease-out, ease), transform 160ms var(--ease-out, ease), box-shadow 200ms var(--ease-out, ease); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-accent, #E8DAC3) 90%, white); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color, #E8DAC3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Action
components.description: A quieter pill action for supporting operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.35); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.10); color: var(--text-main, #E8E6E3); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -18px rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.65); transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.60); box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -18px rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.85); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color, #E8DAC3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A mobile-safe reflective prompt or account field.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field">Your question or intention</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-field" placeholder="What should I focus on?">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--text-muted, #CCC5B9); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--brand-secondary-rgb, 168 157 146) / 0.30); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--bg-surface, #1C1A22); color: var(--text-main, #E8E6E3); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 16px; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: rgb(var(--text-muted-rgb, 204 197 185) / 0.65); } .ds-field:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--brand-secondary-rgb, 168 157 146) / 0.55); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color, #E8DAC3); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--brand-primary, #D4B896); }

components.name: Selection Chip
components.description: A selected preference or compact reading state.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--brand-accent, #E8DAC3); color: var(--text-on-brand, #1C1A22); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; transition: transform 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-accent, #E8DAC3) 90%, white); } .ds-chip:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color, #E8DAC3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Active Navigation Segment
components.description: The active destination in the pill-based application navigation.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--brand-secondary-rgb, 168 157 146) / 0.30); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(var(--bg-surface-rgb, 28 26 34) / 0.80); } .ds-nav-item { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-main, #E8E6E3); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.10); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: var(--brand-primary, #D4B896); color: var(--text-on-brand, #1C1A22); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.30); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color, #E8DAC3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: A standard information container outside the signature reading panels.
components.html:
Reading guidance

Begin with a clear intention

Specific, open-ended questions create more useful reflection.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--brand-secondary-rgb, 168 157 146) / 0.20); border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(var(--bg-surface-rgb, 28 26 34) / 0.78); color: var(--text-main, #E8E6E3); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.70); } .ds-card-label { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--brand-primary, #D4B896); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; color: var(--text-main, #E8E6E3); font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif); font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-card-copy { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted, #CCC5B9); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.35); } .ds-card:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color, #E8DAC3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Mystic Panel
components.description: The atmospheric signature container for spread, deck, and ritual decisions.
components.html:
Spread selection

Choose how your reading unfolds.

Match the layout to the depth of your inquiry.
components.css: .ds-mystic-panel { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border-warm, rgba(232, 218, 195, 0.22)); border-radius: 25.6px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 0% 18%, var(--glow-gold, rgba(244, 207, 150, 0.10)), transparent 40%), radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0%, var(--glow-blue, rgba(120, 161, 255, 0.08)), transparent 38%), radial-gradient(circle at 52% 115%, var(--glow-pink, rgba(255, 132, 178, 0.07)), transparent 46%), linear-gradient(135deg, var(--panel-dark-1, #0D0A14), var(--panel-dark-2, #151020) 55%, var(--panel-dark-3, #0F0B17)); color: var(--text-main, #E8E6E3); box-shadow: 0 24px 64px -40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.80), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); } .ds-mystic-eyebrow { margin: 0; color: var(--brand-accent, #E8DAC3); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mystic-title { margin: 10px 0 0; color: var(--text-main, #E8E6E3); font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif); font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-mystic-copy { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted, #CCC5B9); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-mystic-panel:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-accent, #E8DAC3) 36%, transparent); } .ds-mystic-panel:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color, #E8DAC3); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Spread Card
components.description: The signature selectable card that previews a reading spread.
components.css: .ds-spread-card { display: flex; width: 240px; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding: 16px 18px 22px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.25); border-radius: 21.6px; background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.10), var(--panel-dark-2, #151020)); color: var(--text-main, #E8E6E3); text-align: left; box-shadow: 0 18px 36px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-spread-art { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 14px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 24%, rgba(232, 218, 195, 0.55), transparent 20%), radial-gradient(circle at 32% 62%, rgba(139, 149, 165, 0.50), transparent 28%), linear-gradient(145deg, #151020, #2A2730); } .ds-spread-name { font-family: var(--font-serif, Georgia, serif); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-spread-meta { color: var(--brand-accent, #E8DAC3); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-spread-copy { color: var(--text-muted, #CCC5B9); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-spread-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.50); box-shadow: 0 24px 45px -28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85), 0 8px 22px -18px rgb(var(--brand-primary-rgb, 212 184 150) / 0.40); } .ds-spread-card:active { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-spread-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring-color, #E8DAC3); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Tableu feels like entering a private reading room after dark: contemplative, scholarly, and intimate. Warm candlelight marks the places where a person may act, while deep ink surfaces keep attention on cards, language, and ritual. The atmosphere supports reflection without pretending to be supernatural evidence.

The system is dark-first, softly luminous, and materially restrained. Serif type carries tarot meaning and ceremonial moments; sans-serif type keeps navigation, controls, and explanations direct. Grain, radial light, glass, and motion appear as quiet sensory cues, never as neon-occult spectacle, kitschy mysticism, or casino-like stimulation. Light mode is the same room by day, not a separate identity.

The approved image composition is the implementation contract. Preserve its bold focal hierarchy, proportions, negative space, and atmosphere before making local refinements. Micro-interactions stay responsive, while card dealing, reveals, and other ritual transitions use the slower 400–600ms cadence already present in the motion system.
keyCharacteristics: Warm brass light against near-black, subtly plum-leaning surfaces.
Scholarly serif moments within a highly legible sans-serif operating layer.
Rounded, tactile controls and layered cards with thin warm borders.
Ambient glow and restrained texture instead of ornamental occult excess.
Responsive ritual flows that become carousels and docked actions on handsets.
Bold focal contrast paired with deliberately slower pacing for ceremonial moments.

rules.name: The Candlelight Rule
rules.body: Warm brass identifies action, selection, focus, or tarot meaning; its scarcity gives it authority.

rules.name: The Dark-First Rule
rules.body: Midnight Ink is the default atmosphere. Light mode must preserve the same warm hierarchy rather than becoming a generic white application.

rules.name: The No Neon Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce high-chroma mystical purples, electric gradients, or unrelated rainbow accents into application chrome.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif carries interpretation, ritual, and named artifacts; sans-serif carries operation, explanation, and system state.

rules.name: The Four-Pixel Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Prefer the established 4px-derived spacing steps; introduce a new interval only when card geometry or safe-area math requires it.

rules.name: The Ambient, Not Architectural Rule
rules.body: Use shadow and glow to suggest candlelight, selection, and focus—not to assign arbitrary elevation to every container.

rules.name: The Soft Geometry Rule
rules.body: Rounded forms should feel tactile and calm; avoid both sharp enterprise rectangles and indiscriminate bubble-like rounding.

rules.name: The Quiet Ceremony Rule
rules.body: The approved image composition is the implementation contract: preserve its bold focal hierarchy, proportions, negative space, and atmosphere; reserve the strongest light and slower 400–600ms motion for decisions that advance or reveal a reading.

dos: Do use semantic theme tokens so dark, light, and increased-contrast modes remain aligned.
Do reserve serif type for interpretation, ritual, card names, and major headings.
Do keep body copy and mobile form controls at 16px, with 11px reserved for non-essential metadata only.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, safe-area insets, visible focus, and reduced-motion alternatives.
Do use Candlelit Brass sparingly for selection, progress, focus, and high-value action.
Do let mobile reading choices become swipeable carousels and move the primary next action into the bottom dock.
Do match implementation to the approved image composition before optimizing local details.
donts: Don't use neon mystical palettes, rainbow chrome, or high-energy casino animation.
Don't make every surface glassy, glowing, or heavily shadowed; atmospheric treatments lose meaning when universal.
Don't use Source Serif for dense controls, helper text, or navigation.
Don't introduce text below 11px or mobile inputs below 16px.
Don't encode status using color alone or replace focus rings with hover-only treatments.
Don't turn the light theme into a generic white dashboard; preserve the warm paper-and-brass hierarchy.
Don't dilute the approved focal hierarchy or accelerate ceremonial motion into generic app-speed transitions.
